## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility or upgrade impact.
Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include screenshots for visible changes when useful.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change covers the public core or Nuxt client and contains no commercial module code or secrets.
- [ ] Regression coverage accompanies changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] Affected documentation, English/Vietnamese translations, and the changelog are updated.
- [ ] Public API artifacts are regenerated when the API contract changes.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/douwyncom/douwyn-starter-kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full local quality checks.
